description: This file defines the AxisTitle class, which models the title of an axis in a chart, including properties like style, caption, font, orientation, and alignment. It contains methods for cloning, deep copying, serialization, and property accessors, making it a key component for chart axis customization within the document object model.

classes.name: AxisTitle
classes.description: Represents the title of a chart axis with properties for caption, style, font, orientation, and alignment, along with cloning and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: AxisTitle.AxisTitleValues
classes.description: Contains the internally nullable property values for AxisTitle, including style, caption, font, orientation, and alignments.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this AxisTitle object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying logic for the AxisTitle object, including copying the Font property if present.
